definitions.explanation: A small rocky body orbiting the sun, typically found in the asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter.

examples.japanese: {小惑星|しょうわくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{接近|せっきん}→接近：04365_sekkin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{小惑星|しょうわくせい}⟦ベルト→ベルト：01508_beruto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多く：18752_ooku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小惑星|しょうわくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are many asteroids in the asteroid belt.

examples.japanese: ⟦はやぶさ→はやぶさ：noentry⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{小惑星|しょうわくせい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦サンプル→サンプル：10939_sanpuru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{帰|かえ}った→持ち帰る：04227_mochikaeru⟧。
examples.english: Hayabusa brought back samples from an asteroid.

notes:
{小惑星|しょうわくせい} refers to rocky bodies orbiting the sun, mostly found in the asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter.

FORMS:
⟦{小|しょう}→小：noentry⟧ (small) + ⟦{惑星|わくせい}→惑星：05052_wakusei⟧ (planet) = literally "small planet"

RELATED CELESTIAL BODIES:
- ⟦{惑星|わくせい}→惑星：05052_wakusei⟧: planet
- ⟦{流星|りゅうせい}→流星：06310_ryuusei⟧: meteor, shooting star
- ⟦{彗星|すいせい}→彗星：05053_suisei⟧: comet
- ⟦{隕石|いんせき}→隕石：05054_inseki⟧: meteorite

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小惑星|しょうわくせい}⟦ベルト→ベルト：01508_beruto⟧: asteroid belt
- {小惑星|しょうわくせい}⟦{探査|たんさ}→探査：05325_tansa⟧: asteroid exploration
- {小惑星|しょうわくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{接近|せっきん}→接近：04365_sekkin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: an asteroid approaches

NOTABLE:
Japan's Hayabusa missions successfully returned samples from asteroids Itokawa and Ryugu, making {小惑星|しょうわくせい} a well-known term in Japanese news.
